source_passages.source_title: Filter First: Salience-Guided Input Pruning for Faithful News Summarization
source_passages.text: Before summarization, we apply salience pre-filtering to every source document: a lightweight classifier scores each sentence, sentences scoring below 0.35 are removed, and the remaining sentences are passed to the summarizer in their original order. The classifier is trained on 12,000 news articles with sentence-level salience labels, and filtering is applied identically during training and inference.

source_passages.source_title: Counting What Is Not There: An Annotation Protocol for Entity Hallucination
source_passages.text: We define an unsupported entity as a named entity in a generated summary that neither appears in nor can be inferred from the source document. Each summary is labelled independently by two annotators, with disagreements resolved by a third; inter-annotator agreement on our pilot set was κ = 0.81.

package.experimental_setup: All systems share the same 120M-parameter acoustic encoder and are evaluated on the Brindle-Voice test set (2,000 utterances; mean duration 6.8 s). WER is word error rate (%, lower is better). All WERs were measured by us (Talmar with its released checkpoint). Decoder passes are averaged over the test set. We timed all three systems ourselves on one Corvex A2 accelerator with batch size 1, fp16 precision and the Lumen 3.1 runtime; latency is the wall-clock time from encoder input to final transcript for one utterance, reported as the median over all 2,000 test utterances after 50 warm-up utterances, repeated over 3 runs (run-to-run variation < 2%).

package.methods_summary: Brisling is a non-autoregressive mask-predict decoder that refines a full transcript hypothesis in a fixed 4 parallel decoder passes on top of a shared acoustic encoder. Talmar (Ruiz-Hale et al., 2023) is an autoregressive transformer decoder that emits one token per decoder pass. Greedy-CTC reads the transcript directly from the encoder's CTC head and is included as a reference point.
package.question: How does Brisling compare with Talmar in decoding speed and accuracy on the Brindle-Voice test set?

package.experimental_setup: Models are trained on the Corvane-News NER training set (14,200 sentences, 4 entity types) and evaluated with entity-level F1 on its test set (3,100 sentences); every configuration is trained with 5 random seeds (seeds 0–4). Seed study: we report the spread of test F1 across the 5 seeds when training on the original labels. Label-noise study: for noise rates of 10%, 20% and 30%, that fraction of training entity spans is relabelled with a uniformly random incorrect type; the test set is never corrupted. Pre-specified robustness criterion: a model counts as robust under a perturbation condition if its mean test F1 falls by at most 2.0 points relative to its mean F1 in the unperturbed (original-label) setting.
